# dsh-miliastra v0.7.0

**安装**：`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-miliastra@0.7.0` → **重启 `dsh web`**（Host + Client 两半边都变了）
**Install**: `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-miliastra@0.7.0`, then **restart `dsh web`** (both halves changed).

[中文](#cn-v0.7.0) | [English](#en-v0.7.0)

---

<h3 id="cn-v0.7.0">🚀 新增功能</h3>

- **`miliastra_map` 新增两个 op：`anatomy`（节点图能力画像）与 `regions`（顶层区地图）**
  - `anatomy`：整关/逐图的**节点类型直方图**（事件 / 执行 / 查询 / 运算 / 分支 / **复合节点 / 自定义节点** / 未收录）、端（服务端·客户端）、
    入口事件、引用了哪些实体、关键词（图名加权）—— 一次回答"**这张图在做什么**"。
  - `regions`：把 `.gil` 的**顶层区**摊开（字节数 / 条目数 / 样例名字 / **已知区名**，未确证的一律标未知、不编名字），
    并给 `counts`（实体 / 元件 / 图 / 声明 / 配置 / **场景物件** / **摆放实例** / 阵营）。
- ★★ **「谁身上挂着这张图」—— 读得出来了**（上一版说"读不出来"，那是**错的口径**）
  - 判据是**结构路径**：实体 `#5[i].#6.#13.#1[].#1{ #1=序号, #2=图id, #501=类型号 }`；元件把 `#6` 换成 `#7`（同形）。
    **与编辑器「节点图挂载对象」面板逐条对上**（实测：恐怖-V3 55/57 张图有主）。
  - 回执里每条图带 `owners[]`：`via:"mount"` = **已确证**；`via:"ref"` = 记录里别处指向（本机实测正是那 21 张客户端布尔过滤器图），
    口径未确证 ⇒ **不冒充挂载**。**盲区也写明**：技能图 / 状态图挂在别的区，没找到只能说"这两个区里没找到"。
  - ⚠️ 把上一版的两条**错法**写进回执当反面教材：**名字匹配**、**裸数值命中**都不算证据。
- **「挂在 XX 上的图能做到什么」**：每条图就地给 `entryEvents`（事件类节点名）+ `actions`（执行类节点名去重）
  —— 并注明是**结构与调用清单，不是语义结论**。
- **`miliastra_kb`（新工具）**：节点图知识库
  - `op=qa`（**离线** 29 条蒸馏排查清单：镜头不生效 / 巡逻路径 / 信号收不到 / 背包事件只在道具图上生效 / 角色一死图就没了 / 结算显示"完成" / 复苏点角色≠玩家 …）
  - `op=node`（**离线** 558 条官方节点词典，带端口）；`op=list/doc/search` 是**在线**第三方知识库（会披露 `network:true` + `sentTo`）。
- **面板第 7 页 v2**：节点图 / 实体 / 元件三张表（**搜索 + 每页 10 条**）+ 右侧详情三级下钻（列表 → 图详情 → 节点与引脚连线）；
  图详情新增 **`挂载在` / `入口事件` / `关键动作`** 三行；关卡选择器（默认「**最近存盘的地图（`.gil`）**」，可切 Host 口径 / 手选并记忆）。
- **场景静态也计入**：`sceneObjectCount`（`#27`，本机 1287 条）+ `placedCount`（`#8`，128 条）—— 不再让"实体 12 个"被读成"这张图只有 12 个东西"。
- **信号清单**（`anatomy.signals`）：从 `#10.#2` 信号/参数引用表提取**现场信号名**（减去固定引脚名 + 现场前缀过滤），
  并给八类（整数/字符串/布尔值/浮点数 × 本体/列表）的**按名字匹配**结果。⚠️ 口径不是官方字段号，回执里写明。
- **模板子树 + 贪婪扫**（`op=clientui`）：子控件（`.gil` 的 `#503`）**递归展开**；
  `kind:"all"` 一次摊开**所有**独立模板的完整子树（实测 1813 控件 / 90 棵树 / 最大一棵 581 节点·深 8）。
- **`miliastra_health` 新增 `editorHint`**：明确说清"**编辑器正在编辑哪张图**"**没有直接通道**（窗口标题不含关卡名 / `.gil` 不锁 /
  无自动保存心跳 / 编辑器配置为空 / `Temp` 副本与 `.gil` 同刻），只给两条**间接判据**（`gil`=最近存盘、`live`=活文件最近改动，
  后者**会被 deploy 污染**）+ 该问人什么。系统提示段同步写明：**改码/部署前先问作者一句"现在在哪张图"**。

<h3 id="cn-v0.7.0-fix">🐛 问题修复</h3>

- **P0 · `op=restore` 写错活文件**（真实事故：还原 0 字节的 `背景层 bg.lua` 时没传 `file`，按 `.gil` 挂载名挑目标 ⇒ 把 `表现 view.lua` 覆盖成 3936 B）：
  新增 `inferLiveNameFromBackup()` —— 备份名（`<原名>.bak` / `<原名>.<戳>_备份.lua`）能推断目标就**以它为准**；
  传了 `file` 但与备份名不符 ⇒ **拒绝写盘**（`code:"RESTORE_TARGET_MISMATCH"` + 两条改法）。
- **存盘状态比较必须去掉 UTF-8 BOM**：实测 11 条活文件全带 BOM、而 `.gil` 里嵌的是**去 BOM** 那份（字节数恰好每条少 3）
  ⇒ 直接比 sha 会把**刚存过盘的图判成"该存盘了"**。现在 `liveSha` 远去 BOM 后算（另留 `liveShaRaw` / `bomStripped`），
  "已存盘"时明说"其中 N 条只差 UTF-8 BOM"；**去 BOM 后仍不等 ⇒ 照旧判不一致**（归一化不许放过真差异）。
  另：`只有 BOM、没有内容` 的空文件（如 `背景层 bg.lua`）不再说成"sha 没读到"，而是**点名说清"两边都没内容可对"**。
- **元件被静默截断在 40 个** ⇒ 显式给足上限（恐怖-V3 实测 40 → **71**），并把各块 `truncated{}` 透出到回执。
- **实体名"深取"**：名字有时藏在 `#11` 里再套一层，原来直接解码会把 tag 字节当文本 ⇒ 面板一片「(无名)」；现在无名 **0 个**，
  真读不出来时回退成 `(无名 #<id>)`。同理修了场景物件 / 摆放实例的名字。
- **样式跟着 bundle 更新**：样式注入原本用固定 id + "存在就 return" ⇒ 出现"**新 JS + 旧 CSS**"（表格没样式、数字挤两行）；
  现在按 CSS 内容指纹比对，不一致就**换掉旧的**。
- **brief 档实测 1951 B（远超自我要求的 1 KB）**：`currentEvidence + currentAlternatives`（路径 + 3 个 ISO 时间戳对象）
  合成一行 `currentWhy`；活文件 > 8 个时不再逐条给 `bytes` ⇒ 实测 **1348 B**，并补了"真实形状"的回归断言。
- **计数在早退路径上是 `undefined`**（如坦克大战的声明数）⇒ 四个读取函数的返回对象创建时即给 0。
- **面板关卡默认口径**改成「**最近存盘的地图（`.gil`）**」：原来按"任何文件最近"会被 **deploy 改过的活文件**抢走。

<h3 id="cn-v0.7.0-chores">⚠️ 其他变更</h3>

- 工具 schema 追加 `regions` 等 op 后，**schema 体积仍在 34 KB 棘轮内**（33.9 KB）；新增两个 op 的 `miliastra_map` description 已同步精简。
- `docs/工具参考.md` 重新生成（`readme-test` 逐字比对）。
- ⚠️ **重启 `dsh web`** 后本版所有新 op / 新回执字段才在 AI 会话里生效；面板另需 F5。

<h3 id="en-v0.7.0">🚀 New Features</h3>

- **Two new ops on `miliastra_map`: `anatomy` (node-graph capability profile) and `regions` (top-level region map)**
  - `anatomy`: node-type histogram per graph (Trigger / Execution / Query / Arithmetic / Control / **Composite / Custom** / Unknown),
    side (server·client), entry events, referenced entities, weighted keywords — answers "**what is this graph doing**" in one call.
  - `regions`: dumps the `.gil`'s top-level regions (bytes / item count / sample names / **confirmed labels only** — unverified ones stay
    unlabeled on purpose) plus `counts` (entities / components / graphs / declarations / configs / **scene objects** / **placed instances** / factions).
- ★★ **"Which object owns this graph" is now readable** (v0.6.4 said it wasn't — that conclusion was **based on a wrong criterion**)
  - The criterion is a **structural path**: entity `#5[i].#6.#13.#1[].#1{ #1=index, #2=graph id, #501=type code }`; components swap `#6` for `#7`
    (same shape). **Verified item-by-item against the editor's "node graph mount targets" panel** (55/57 graphs on one real map).
  - Each graph now carries `owners[]`: `via:"mount"` = **confirmed**; `via:"ref"` = a reference found elsewhere in the record (measured to be
    exactly those client-side boolean-filter graphs) and explicitly **not** presented as a mount. **Blind spots are stated**: skill/state
    graphs hang off other regions, so a miss only means "not found in these two regions".
  - The two **wrong criteria** from v0.6.4 are kept in the receipt as a warning: **name matching** and **bare-number hits** are not evidence.
- **"What can the graph mounted on X do"**: each graph now carries `entryEvents` (trigger node names) and `actions` (deduplicated execution
  node names) — explicitly labelled as a structural/call list, **not** a semantic conclusion.
- **`miliastra_kb` (new tool)**: node-graph knowledge base — `op=qa` (29 **offline** distilled troubleshooting checklists), `op=node`
  (558-entry **offline** official node dictionary with ports); `op=list/doc/search` proxy an **online** third-party KB and disclose
  `network:true` + `sentTo`.
- **Panel page 7 v2**: searchable, 10-per-page tables for graphs / entities / components, with three-level drill-down on the right
  (list → graph → node & pin wiring); graph detail gained **`mounted on` / `entry events` / `key actions`**; a level picker defaulting to
  **the most recently saved map archive**.
- **Scene/static objects are now counted** too: `sceneObjectCount` (`#27`, 1287 on a real map) + `placedCount` (`#8`, 128).
- **Signal inventory** (`anatomy.signals`): signal names extracted from the `#10.#2` reference table (pins removed + prefix filter), plus
  name-matched presence for the 8 classes (int/string/bool/float × scalar/list). Criterion is honest about not being an official field id.
- **Template subtrees + greedy scan** (`op=clientui`): child controls (`.gil` `#503`) are expanded recursively; `kind:"all"` dumps the full
  subtree of **every** standalone template (measured: 1813 controls / 90 trees / largest 581 nodes, depth 8).
- **`miliastra_health.editorHint`**: states plainly that there is **no direct channel** for "which map is the editor editing"
  (window titles carry no level name / `.gil` is not locked / no autosave heartbeat / editor config is empty / `Temp` copy shares the
  `.gil`'s timestamp) and gives only two **indirect** signals, warning that the live-file one **gets polluted by deploys**.

<h3 id="en-v0.7.0-fix">🐛 Bug Fixes</h3>

- **P0 · `op=restore` wrote the wrong live file** (real incident: restoring the 0-byte `背景层 bg.lua` without `file` picked a target by
  `.gil` mount name and overwrote `表现 view.lua`, 67668 B → 3936 B). New `inferLiveNameFromBackup()`: when the backup file name identifies
  its live file, that name wins; if it disagrees with an explicit `file`, the operation is **refused** (`RESTORE_TARGET_MISMATCH`).
- **Save-state comparison must strip the UTF-8 BOM**: all 11 live files carried a BOM while the `.gil` embeds the BOM-less copy (exactly
  3 bytes smaller), so a raw sha comparison reported "needs saving" for a freshly saved map. `liveSha` is now the BOM-stripped hash
  (`liveShaRaw` / `bomStripped` kept), and a BOM-only difference is reported as such — **while a difference that survives BOM stripping
  still counts as a difference**.
- **Components were silently truncated at 40** (fixed: 40 → 71 on a real map), and each reader's `truncated{}` now surfaces in the receipt.
- **Entity-name deep read**: names nested one level deeper were being dropped (panel showed a wall of "(unnamed)") — now zero unnamed.
- **Styles now follow the bundle**: the old fixed style id plus "return if present" produced "new JS + old CSS" (unstyled tables); the
  injector now compares a CSS content fingerprint and replaces a stale `<style>`.
- **`brief` receipt measured 1951 B** (vs. its own < 1 KB budget, because the existing tests ran on fixtures): compressed to **1348 B**.
- **Counts were `undefined` on early-return paths**; readers now initialize them to 0.
- **Panel level default** changed to the **most recently saved map archive**, because "most recently touched file" was being hijacked by
  **deploy-written live files**.

<h3 id="en-v0.7.0-chores">⚠️ Chores</h3>

- Tool schema stayed within the 34 KB ratchet (33.9 KB) despite the new ops.
- `docs/工具参考.md` regenerated (`readme-test` compares it verbatim).
- ⚠️ **Restart `dsh web`** for every new op / receipt field to reach AI sessions; press F5 for the panel.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-miliastra/compare/v0.6.4...v0.7.0
